```yaml
name: Build Linux No-Container

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      platform:
        description: 'Platform to build for'
        required: true
        type: string
        default: 'linux-x64'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: self-hosted
    strategy:
      matrix:
        platform: [linux-x64, linux-arm64]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Setup Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.8'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake git libopenblas-dev liblapack-dev

    - name: Clone Flash Attention repository
      run: git clone https://github.com/HazyResearch/flash-attention.git

    - name: Create virtual environment
      run: python -m venv venv

    - name: Activate virtual environment
      run: source venv/bin/activate

    - name: Install build requirements
      run: pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

    - name: Build Flash Attention
      run: cd flash-attention && make

    - name: Collect wheels
      id: collect_wheels
      run: |
        mkdir -p wheels
        find . -name "*.whl" -exec mv {} wheels/ \;
        echo "wheels_path=$(pwd)/wheels" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

    - name: Upload wheels
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: flash-attention-wheels-${{ matrix.platform }}
        path: wheels

    - name: Clean up
      run: |
        rm -rf flash-attention venv ~/.cache/pip ~/.cache/uvicorn
        sudo apt-get clean
        sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
```

This workflow sets up a Linux environment on a self-hosted runner, clones the Flash Attention repository, creates a virtual environment, installs dependencies, builds the project, collects the generated wheels, uploads them as an artifact, and cleans up unnecessary files and directories. The workflow is triggered manually via the GitHub Actions UI and can be configured to run on different platforms by specifying the `platform` input.
